criteria.no: The item lacks that requirement: no manifest, no per-file hashes, an archive-level hash only, or hashes for only part of the shipped files.
criteria.unclear: The item mentions hashes or a manifest but does not settle whether every shipped file has one.
criteria.yes: The item requires a published manifest containing a hash for each shipped skill file, including agents, skills and Python files.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` require the published skill to carry a manifest with the hash of every shipped file, so each installed file can be checked against it? The required content is per-file hashes covering all shipped files, recorded in a published manifest. Judge presence only.

criteria.no: The item states no such decision; silence, a compliant plan, or omitting non-shipped repository files is no conflict.
criteria.unclear: The item may ship some files without hashes, but it cannot be told.
criteria.yes: The item decides to ship some files unhashed, to publish only an archive-level hash, or to publish no manifest.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` state a decision under which the published manifest would not hold a hash of every shipped file? Silence about the manifest is not conflict.

criteria.no: The item concerns a different activity than publishing the atm-bd skill, such as LLM call retries.
criteria.unclear: The item mentions packaging or hashing but not clearly for the atm-bd skill.
criteria.yes: The item concerns publishing or packaging the atm-bd skill, or the manifest or file hashes published with it.

relevant.instructions: The anchor is about what the atm-bd skill ships when it is published so an installer can verify files. Does `item.text` touch publishing the atm-bd skill or the file hashes and manifest that ship with it? Judge subject overlap only.

anchor.statement: The published skill must include a manifest containing the hash of every shipped file.

item.text: The release manifest lists the hash of every file shipped in the published skill package; repository files that are not shipped, such as CI configuration, are left out of the manifest.
